title: Millennium Stadium
visualBrief: Specific Millennium/Principality Stadium: exact mapped rounded body/rectangular roof aperture, dark fixed side roofs and pale parked retractable end panels in one open configuration, closed roof skins/visible undersides/longitudinal girders/end lattice, four tapered open mast frames/pointed heads/stays, muted red three-tier bowl with distinctive lower two-tier north stand/corner gaps, neutral rugby floor/linework/H-goals, supported neutral end displays, blue/red curved glazed facade/exposed upper columns/ribs, stair-service cores and major recessed entry/stair groups. Five existing shared concrete/paint/standing-seam/window-grid/canvas graphs. No animated roof mechanism, copied text/live pixels, crowd/event fixtures, furnished service interior, independent Arms Park stand/office/river wall or whole-site platform.
